b2-salvadorhonduras-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Stelae?
b2-salvadorhonduras-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Copán, and he asks you what makes the city special.
b2-salvadorhonduras-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what Copán is famous for.
cues: Say that Copán is a Maya city
b2-salvadorhonduras-01.target: Copán es una ciudad maya cuyas estelas son famosas.
b2-salvadorhonduras-01.english: Copán is a Maya city whose stelae are famous.
b2-salvadorhonduras-01.canDo: I can say whose monuments or coasts I am talking about, with *cuyo*, *cuya*, *cuyos* and *cuyas*.

b2-salvadorhonduras-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Workers Said
b2-salvadorhonduras-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading an article about northern Honduras, and she asks you about the banana strike of 1954.
b2-salvadorhonduras-02.prompt: Tell Meg what the workers said and how long the strike lasted, naming the source.
cues: Say what the workers said they wanted
Say how long the strike lasted, according to historians
b2-salvadorhonduras-02.target: Los trabajadores dijeron que querían mejores salarios. Según los historiadores, la huelga duró más de dos meses.
b2-salvadorhonduras-02.english: The workers said they wanted better wages. According to historians, the strike lasted more than two months.
b2-salvadorhonduras-02.canDo: I can report what people said, with *dijo que* and the right past tense.

b2-salvadorhonduras-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Quiet Bishop?
b2-salvadorhonduras-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are listening to a talk about El Salvador, and he asks you about Archbishop Romero.
b2-salvadorhonduras-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what people expected of Romero and what he did.
cues: Show the contrast with what Romero did
b2-salvadorhonduras-03.target: Muchos esperaban un obispo tranquilo; sin embargo, Romero habló por las víctimas.
b2-salvadorhonduras-03.english: Many expected a quiet bishop; however, Romero spoke for the victims.
b2-salvadorhonduras-03.canDo: I can show a contrast between two facts, with *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.

b2-salvadorhonduras-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why They Left
b2-salvadorhonduras-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading an article about migration from Honduras, and she asks you why so many people left in 1998.
b2-salvadorhonduras-04.prompt: Tell Meg why many Hondurans emigrated.
b2-salvadorhonduras-04.target: A raíz del huracán Mitch, muchas familias perdieron sus casas y sus cosechas.
b2-salvadorhonduras-04.english: As a result of Hurricane Mitch, many families lost their houses and their harvests.
b2-salvadorhonduras-04.canDo: I can give a cause with *debido a* and *a raíz de* and a noun.

b2-salvadorhonduras-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Dated Fact
b2-salvadorhonduras-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are following the news about Honduras, and he asks you about the 2025 election.
b2-salvadorhonduras-05.prompt: Tell Carlos who was declared the winner and when.
cues: Say who was declared the winner
b2-salvadorhonduras-05.target: Nasry Asfura fue declarado ganador el 24 de diciembre de 2025.
b2-salvadorhonduras-05.english: Nasry Asfura was declared the winner on 24 December 2025.
b2-salvadorhonduras-05.canDo: I can say what was approved, declared or announced, with *ser* + past participle.

b2-salvadorhonduras-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: El Salvador and Honduras
b2-salvadorhonduras-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip to Honduras, and she asks what you remember about Copán and the war in El Salvador.
b2-salvadorhonduras-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg one fact about each.
cues: Say whose stelae are famous in Copán
Say how long the war in El Salvador lasted, with a contrast
b2-salvadorhonduras-consolidation.target: Copán es una ciudad cuyas estelas son famosas. La guerra duró doce años; sin embargo, en 1992 se firmó la paz.
b2-salvadorhonduras-consolidation.english: Copán is a city whose stelae are famous. The war lasted twelve years; however, peace was signed in 1992.
b2-salvadorhonduras-consolidation.canDo: I can say whose monuments or coasts I mean, with *cuyo*.
